conbody.p: The rear view function of the surround view monitor while driving helps you safely drive by displaying the rear view of the vehicle while driving. The rear view while driving includes a rear view while driving and a rear wide view while driving, and you can switch to the desired view mode by pressing the view switch button (2) on the surround view monitor screen.

li.p: The rear view function of the surround view monitor while driving operates under the following conditions.
When driving over 10 km/h (6 mph), press the parking/view button (1).
When driving below 10 km/h (6 mph), push the rear view switch button (2) on the surround view monitor screen while driving.
The rear view function of the surround view monitor while driving is disabled under the following conditions.
Press the parking/view button (1) or the infotainment system operation button (4).
Shift to P (Park)When driving below 10 km/h (6 mph), press the other view mode button (2) on the surround view monitor screen.
Press the home button (3) on the surround view monitor screen.
